clips.zh: 这件事很重要，我们必须认真对待。
clips.en: This matter is very important; we must treat it seriously.
notes: 必须 bìxū: a fall, then a high flat tone.
认真 rènzhēn: a fall, then a high flat tone.

clips.zh: 我们要重视这个问题，重新检查一遍。
clips.en: We must take this problem seriously and check it again.
notes: 重视 zhòngshì: 重 is said zhòng (heavy, serious) here, a fall.
重新 chóngxīn: 重 is said chóng (again) here, a rise.

clips.zh: 我感觉有点累，想早点睡觉。
clips.en: I feel a bit tired and want to go to bed early.
notes: 感觉 gǎnjué: 觉 is said jué (a rise) in this word; 感 only dips.
睡觉 shuìjiào: 觉 is said jiào (a fall) in this word.

clips.zh: 他还没有把书还给图书馆。
clips.en: He has not yet returned the book to the library.
notes: 还没有 hái méiyǒu: 还 is said hái (still, yet), a rise.
还给 huán gěi: 还 is said huán (give back), also a rise.

clips.zh: 我去银行取钱，顺便买了一些水果。
clips.en: I went to the bank to take out money and bought some fruit on the way.
notes: 银行 yínháng: 行 is said háng (a rise) when it means a bank.
水果 shuǐguǒ: two third tones in a row, so 水 rises (say shuíguǒ).

clips.zh: 我的爱好很多，比如爬山、游泳和旅游。
clips.en: I have many hobbies, such as climbing mountains, swimming and travelling.
notes: 爱好 àihào: 好 is said hào (a fall) when it means to like.
比如 bǐrú: 比 only dips before the rising 如.

clips.zh: 他不但不生气，反而笑了。
clips.en: Not only was he not angry, he laughed instead.
notes: 不但 búdàn: 不 is said bú before the falling 但.
不生气 bù shēngqì: 不 stays bù before a high flat tone.

clips.zh: 我一直觉得这两个办法一样好。
clips.en: I have always thought these two methods are equally good.
notes: 一直 yìzhí: 一 is said yì (a fall) before the rising 直.
一样 yíyàng: 一 is said yí (a rise) before the falling 样.

clips.zh: 请你管理好自己的时间，不要浪费。
clips.en: Please manage your time well and do not waste it.
notes: 管理 guǎnlǐ: two third tones in a row, so 管 rises (say guánlǐ).
浪费 làngfèi: both syllables fall.

clips.zh: 这个地方的水果又新鲜又便宜，老板也很热情。
clips.en: The fruit in this place is both fresh and cheap, and the boss is friendly too.
notes: 地方 dìfang: the second syllable is light and short.
老板 lǎobǎn: two third tones in a row, so 老 rises (say láobǎn).

clips.zh: 这次旅游的计划已经决定了，大家都很期待。
clips.en: The plan for this trip has been decided, and everyone is looking forward to it.
notes: 旅游 lǚyóu: 旅 has the rounded ü sound and only dips before the rising 游.
期待 qīdài: a high flat tone, then a fall.

clips.zh: 老师支持我们参加比赛，还鼓励我们认真准备。
clips.en: The teacher supports us in taking part in the competition and also encourages us to prepare seriously.
notes: 支持 zhīchí: both syllables start with the curled-tongue sounds zh and ch.
鼓励 gǔlì: 鼓 only dips before the falling 励.

clips.zh: 他选择了一个全新的职业，希望积累更多的经验。
clips.en: He chose a completely new career and hopes to gain more experience.
notes: 选择 xuǎnzé: x is a soft hiss made with the tongue tip behind the lower teeth.
职业 zhíyè: a rise, then a fall.

clips.zh: 孩子们高兴地跑进了教室。
clips.en: The children ran into the classroom happily.
notes: 高兴地 gāoxìng de: 地 is light (de) and joins the adjective to the verb.
教室 jiàoshì: both syllables fall.

clips.zh: 这么多作业，你一个晚上做得了吗？
clips.en: Can you finish so much homework in one evening?
notes: 做得了 zuò de liǎo: 了 is said liǎo here, meaning 'able to'.
晚上 wǎnshang: the second syllable is light and short.

clips.zh: 暑假的时候，我回老家看了爷爷奶奶。
clips.en: During the summer holiday, I went back to my hometown to see my grandparents.
notes: 暑假 shǔjià: 假 is said jià (holiday), a fall; 暑 only dips.
爷爷 yéye: the second syllable is light and short.

clips.zh: 听音乐能让人放松，也能让人感到快乐。
clips.en: Listening to music can help people relax and can also make people feel happy.
notes: 音乐 yīnyuè: 乐 is said yuè (music), a fall.
快乐 kuàilè: 乐 is said lè (happy), a fall.

clips.zh: 我儿子长得很快，已经比我高了。
clips.en: My son is growing fast and is already taller than me.
notes: 长得 zhǎng de: 长 is said zhǎng (to grow), a dip; 得 is light.
比我 bǐ wǒ: two third tones in a row, so 比 rises (say bíwǒ).

clips.zh: 我希望你能理解我的想法。
clips.en: I hope you can understand my thinking.
notes: 理解 lǐjiě: two third tones in a row, so 理 rises (say líjiě).
希望 xīwàng: a high flat tone, then a fall.

clips.zh: 办这个手续有点麻烦，需要很多材料。
clips.en: Doing this procedure is a bit troublesome and requires many materials.
notes: 麻烦 máfan: the second syllable is light and short.
手续 shǒuxù: 手 only dips before the falling 续.

clips.zh: 由于下大雨，比赛被推迟到了下个星期。
clips.en: Because of the heavy rain, the match was put off until next week.
notes: 由于 yóuyú: both syllables rise.
推迟 tuīchí: a high flat tone, then a rise.

clips.zh: 他的关心让我感到非常温暖。
clips.en: His concern makes me feel very warm.
notes: 温暖 wēnnuǎn: a high flat tone, then a dip.
感到 gǎndào: 感 only dips before the falling 到.

clips.zh: 会议将在下午三点半准时开始。
clips.en: The meeting will start on time at half past three this afternoon.
notes: 三点半 sān diǎn bàn: 点 only dips before the falling 半.
开始 kāishǐ: a high flat tone, then a dip.

clips.zh: 他说话的声音很轻，我几乎听不清楚。
clips.en: He speaks in a very soft voice, and I can hardly hear clearly.
notes: 几乎 jīhū: both syllables are high and flat.
清楚 qīngchu: the second syllable is light and short.
